title: Every fee line a reader sees states the new rules: one capped finder's fee, 0% on your own people, and a free Space that sells nothing

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-18 (project thread: Rethink our take rates): "Fan out a make all the changes site wide to the new system. Make sure you get every instance and page." "Make sure you fully update every bit of copy on the site." ADR-1978. Pin rewrites approved by the owner 2026-11-18 ("Yes, all groups in the doc").

detail: The pricing page, the comparison grid, the pricing FAQ, the niche doors, the comparison pages, the page-editor templates, the in-app plan box, the Space payments and billing pages, the upgrade panel, the answer-engine routes (llms.txt, llms-full.txt), the help center and the canon docs said tips were open on every plan, quoted a network fee ladder by plan with no cap, promised a free Space tips, and listed donations as a Business feature. DONE 2026-11-19: the shared spine (lib/pricing/plan-story.ts) states the rule once; the grid and every offering carry the finder's fee with its cap, read from the operator vector (findersFeePhrase, Offering.findersFee); the free membership says it takes no money, Crew says tips, a free Space says donations and tips; help articles state the rule without figures and point at /pricing for the rate and cap. Known limits: the published page rows in the database (home, about, spaces and others) are not regenerated from templates and still carry the old words until a data step rewrites them; the /build/how brief keeps its historical figures; visual baselines for /pricing were recaptured on the branch. Third pass 2026-11-19: the llms-full ladder label says Fees, not Take-rate. The /build/how brief and three stale code comments ship with the help center PR, to keep this one under the 40-file gate.

verify.note: Passes while no reader-facing source carries the retired fee copy and the spine states the finder's fee and its cap. Fails on main at a5684bf86.
